Akeyless also supports regulatory compliance by automating rotation, audit trails, and reporting to meet PCI DSS, HIPAA and SOC two standards.
Managing infrastructure, monitoring uptime, and providing twenty four seven support added unnecessary complexity and cost.
Simpris chose Akeyless for its easy onboarding, high level of support, and true SaaS simplicity, delivering secure secrets management with zero maintenance.
